g.text: User: _id, username + role (unique together), password hash, name, city
Organization: name, description, Bahrain address, contacts, logo/public ID, coordinates, review
Organization 1 ── many Campaign: organizationId references Organization
Campaign: title, description, category, startsAt, endsAt, capacity, address, coordinates, cover
Campaign: status, reviewReason, wasPublished, participants[], favorites[], certificates[]
Campaign 1 ── many CampaignUpdate: campaignId references Campaign
User 1 ── many CampaignUpdate: authorId references the owning Organizer
CampaignUpdate: nonempty text, createdAt, updatedAt; newest updates first
User IDs in participants, favorites, and certificates reference Volunteer accounts.
No Registration or Certificate collection; PDFs are generated on request.
